patches.rationale: Exchange incoming and active states as before; skip animation-node resets when the incoming node is NULL. Original static defeat otherwise writes through NULL into low-memory vectors.
preconditions: Original raw payload and exact instruction boundaries match.
Incoming state and object descriptor pointers are valid; only the animation-node pointer may be NULL.
At least 12 bytes below entry SP are writable and disjoint from object, descriptor, state, node, and code; the original routine required 8.
